title: Royal BC Museum Admission Ticket
includes: Admission to the Royal BC Museum
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Admission to BC's premier repository of history & artefacts.
Exhibitions that revisit centuries of natural events.
A look at the life of a woolly mammoth during the Ice Age. 
Historical sites and authentic totem poles on the precinct.
